address: Stall 11, The Grid - Food Market, Power Plant Mall, Rockwell Drive corner Estrella, Makati - Metro Manila, 1210, The Philippines
bio: This counter in the food market serves its delicious signature ribbon-like noodles featuring a chewy and elastic feature. The chef draws on her experience in a Chinese restaurant in New York City to create a menu of Chinese favourites. The pork and shrimp wontons are crisp, with fragrant pork and spicy shrimp.
